justification: Both surfaces present animals as raised, silhouetted profile figures arranged in stacked horizontal registers on a flat upright panel, with a large quadruped shown side-on above smaller bird-like creatures below, and both render legs, snout and body mass in the same modelled-relief convention rather than incised outline. The difference is in the specific inventory and density: A carries a richer programme (a row of identical crouching quadrupeds along the top, a woven/hatched band, long-necked birds, a snake and a fox-like animal), while B shows essentially one dominant animal with a sparse lower register, so the correspondence is at the level of shared conventions rather than the same scene.
